title: Recover a completed static review
description: Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY, FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_RUN_ID and FARMSLOT_REVIEW_EXPECT_REPORT_SHA256 captured from the original report. Read-only verification through the production gateway; does not launch a reviewer or publish a review.

saved-report.intent: Verify recovery after checkout cleanup preserves the exact report hash and commit, completes monitor without another dispatch and presents the original report for a publication decision.
